what: A file that is not GeoJSON, CSV, XLSX, GPKG or ZIP is never retained by the Studio drop.
whyItBlocksTheDemo: The judges' unknown file gets 'Not imported'; nothing is kept, probed or worded.
proposedTask: One door that retains any file of any size into the batch; the Studio sends every file there.
notes: Small originals: /sources takes geojson|csv|xlsx only; /intake/archives takes ZIP only (16 MiB).
Large originals: /uploads accepts any bytes but only above 16 MiB + 1 (contract min).
So a 3 MB PDF, TIFF, LAZ, IFC, KML, DXF or JPEG has no product door into a batch.
Lead decision needed: drop the 16 MiB minimum on /uploads, or add a small retain-any route.

what: A probed item with no batch reader rests "undecided" with no reason, not "not_understood".
whyItBlocksTheDemo: An unknown or unsupported file sits as "Not placed yet" forever; design 9 promises words.
proposedTask: Each non-vector or unknown card rests not_understood (or kept) with its signature in words.
notes: queueIntakeDraftTx returns null for family != vector and writes no limit_reason.
Covers document, image, raster, point_cloud, model3d, table (via intake) and unknown families.

what: The confirmation run has no lease heartbeat; a lost lease is counted as a refusal and stops targets.
whyItBlocksTheDemo: Confirming 21 packages can pass the 180 s lease; its listed buildings are then stopped.
proposedTask: Heartbeat per committed package; an expired lease is an infrastructure fault, not a refusal.
notes: commit() loops every named package in one attempt; pinned() asserts the attempt after each.
Expired lease -> conflict() -> AppError 409 -> intakeRunRefusal -> stopTx + job failed.
Cost per package is unconfirmed: LQ1b saw press to first card 12.0 s for one 1,661 package.
21 packages x ~10 s ~ 210 s > 180 s: an estimate, not a run. Proof needs G05.

what: After its packages are recorded no building can get a card from the Studio beyond the first 100.
whyItBlocksTheDemo: 41,809 recorded, 100 cards; a judge asking for the card of building 101 gets none.
proposedTask: A cards-only confirmation for recorded targets, from the batch page and the inspector.
notes: A confirmation needs >= 1 uncommitted package; a committed one is refused; targets must be ready.
The register page's issue action is for a unit with an assigned code, not an intake building.

what: Confirmation to card has never run on an empty rehearsal runtime; REH2 to REH5 stop before it.
whyItBlocksTheDemo: The one officer press is the demo climax and is proved only in task harnesses (E1, LQ1b).
proposedTask: REH6: from empty, NYC then Niagara, confirm in the Studio; time commit, records, cards.
notes: Runtime owner task; the owner approves the rehearsal roll. Measures G03 and G08 cost for real.

what: Window reads draw proposals only from the newest 30 packages of an area.
whyItBlocksTheDemo: A file over ~60,000 features (30 x 2,000) loses older proposals from the map silently.
proposedTask: Window reads take every reviewed package of the area that meets the window (see G07).
notes: Niagara (21 packages) fits; the owner target is 500,000 features = 250 packages.
The context read shares areaDisplayPackages, so it has the same cut.

what: Proposal outlines have no spatial index; every window read parses every package body (~1.5 s).
whyItBlocksTheDemo: Each view takes 4 reads, 8.4 to 10 s, at 41,809; it grows with every package added.
proposedTask: Write geographic_geometry on the revision-0 row at draft; window SQL uses the GiST index.
notes: Options and recommendation: see report.md "Proposal outline index". No schema step for option A.
Step 0: EXPLAIN ANALYZE on the rehearsal to split 1.5 s between the rule read and the parse.

what: Commit cost at scale is unmeasured; all commits serialise on one global advisory lock.
whyItBlocksTheDemo: 41,809 buildings x ~9 statements each under one lock; duration unconfirmed.
proposedTask: Measure in G05; if over budget, batch the per-feature UPDATE/INSERTs with unnest per package.
notes: Lock: pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('physical-area-recording',0)) in commitPackage.
Per feature: lock row, update feature, insert revision, close and insert identifiers, record.

what: Table rows never become facts on a building: execution refuses tables; no key index is written.
whyItBlocksTheDemo: A register dropped beside the map stops at mapped rows; the card cites the map only.
proposedTask: AU4-B1 to AU4-B4 as proposed (contracts, exact-key candidates, citations on cards, Studio).
ownedPaths: as listed per task in docs/evidence/gf1/au4/proposal.json
notes: usp_holding_keys exists in SQL; no server code inserts into it (grep, this checkout).
AU4 estimate 44 to 66 worker-hours; needs a real table and document sharing a key (data).

what: A PDF in a batch is not read; the building "Add files" for PDFs is a local draft route only.
whyItBlocksTheDemo: Demo items 2 and 4 (Tower 3 storeys, Magnolia rooms) cannot start from a Studio drop.
proposedTask: A batch PDF starts the existing document receipt and page reader; pages attach by key.
notes: POST /buildings/:id/imports(/inspect) is mode local, draft: not in docs/api/openapi.json.
The Studio calls no documents route (grep of apps/studio/src).

what: Large or multi-format vectors stop: GPKG, shapefile ZIP and KML have no intake recipe.
whyItBlocksTheDemo: A judge GeoPackage over 16 MiB or 2,000 features, or any KML, cannot reach a package.
proposedTask: SH1 (retained-source recipe for shapefile/GPKG through the front door), then a KML area import.
notes: Bounded direct import of GPKG and shapefile ZIP reaches a card (CB1) but outside the batch.
Whether that direct-import path is walkable to a card from the Studio today: unconfirmed.

what: A GeoJSON layer over 16 MiB inside a ZIP is not taken out; the ZIP item says so.
whyItBlocksTheDemo: A judge ZIP holding one big layer yields no map; only the words.
proposedTask: Extract a large member by stream as its own large original and enrol it on the large path.

what: Tables are buffered whole and stop at 2,000 rows and 16 MiB; the table page cannot send more.
whyItBlocksTheDemo: A real register (tens of thousands of rows) is refused; owner target is 1,000,000 rows.
proposedTask: B4: CSV/XLSX read as a stream in parts with the plan-once ladder; large upload for tables.

what: Orthophoto, terrain raster and point cloud in a batch are not imported, read or drawn.
whyItBlocksTheDemo: The NYC pack ortho, DEM and LiDAR stay inside the ZIP; a judge GeoTIFF or LAZ goes nowhere.
proposedTask: AU3 SURFACE-BACKEND, SURFACE-MAP, SURFACE-DROP as proposed (44 worker-hours, within 16 MiB).
ownedPaths: as listed per task in docs/evidence/gf1/au3/proposal.json
notes: No SURFACE-* commit on staging (git log). LAS uncompressed is refused; LAZ 1.4 format 6 only.

what: IFC is read as metadata only: no structure scan of building, storeys and spaces.
whyItBlocksTheDemo: A judge IFC gives no building, levels or spaces to review.
proposedTask: IFC pass 1: streaming scan of spatial structure into candidates without geometry.

what: Large GeoJSON ceilings are 128 MiB and 4,096 parts (409,600 features).
whyItBlocksTheDemo: Owner targets are 1 GB and 500,000 features; a bigger file rests not_understood.
proposedTask: Raise the reader ceilings with one measured run on a real file near 1 GB.

what: Lifetime caps count across the runtime: 128 v1 uploads and 512 MiB reserved ever, 8 v2 ever.
whyItBlocksTheDemo: Rehearsals on the demo runtime spend its allowance; the live drop is then refused 429.
proposedTask: B2: quotas by activity and age, not lifetime counts; or a fresh runtime for the day (owner).
notes: Whether the large GeoJSON path consumes the 128 streaming-vector requests ever: unconfirmed.

what: The area map has no way back to its batch confirmation; a proposal opens an empty register.
whyItBlocksTheDemo: After drawing Niagara the officer cannot confirm from the map; the inspector shows a 404.
proposedTask: The window inspector of a proposal links its batch and says it is not yet confirmed.
notes: No reference to a batch or case route in apps/studio/src/features/map/MapWorkspace.tsx (grep).

what: No live Sarvam call has run; the eleven keys are not loaded on the demo runtime.
whyItBlocksTheDemo: An unseen layout falls to the officer's question; the learner panel shows no teacher calls.

whyItBlocksTheDemo: On a used runtime our NYC file answers "already the source of an area" live.
proposedTask: Owner approves a fresh runtime (or a reviewed cleaning) for the presentation.

what: Late arrivals and the closing pass are not built: a file after the cards changes nothing.
whyItBlocksTheDemo: Drop order matters on the day; a register dropped after confirmation attaches to nothing.
proposedTask: Part of AU4-B2/B3: waiting keys and the symmetric lookup when an anchor is written.
